records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

A quick nudge: Wrenfield works best once your team's actual tasks are in it. If you've been meaning to set that up, today's as good a day as any.

Warmly,

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Union Studio!
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Glad to have Union Studio on Wrenfield. A good first step is setting up one real project with your actual tasks rather than a test one -- it makes the rest of the product click faster.

Let me know if you'd like a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to three Wrenfield touches (email:bf5f6685, email:99a7331d, email:20fcb995). No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Silent starter accounts that haven't created a project by day 6 rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

I know launching a new tool competes with real work, so I'll keep this brief. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real project with Union Studio's actual tasks is usually all it takes for the rest to make sense. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd rather do it solo.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to sit with you while you set up that first project and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
